title: ML Ops Engineers
raw_description:
Role Overview

As a Senior AI/MLOps Engineer specializing in ML Pipeline & Platform Engineering, you will play a pivotal role in scaling Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison's AI and data intelligence capabilities across our digital ecosystem. In this role, you will be responsible for the end-to-end design, automation, and operational management of high-throughput machine learning pipelines and cloud platform environments on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You will empower data scientists and AI engineers by building robust CI/CD deployment automation, optimizing high-scale BigQuery workflows, enforcing zero-trust platform security guardrails, and supporting emerging Agentic AI platform integrations to accelerate Indonesia's digital transformation.

 

Key Responsibilities

 

  • Architect and Operate ML Pipelines: Design, build, compile, and maintain enterprise-grade Kubeflow Pipelines (KFP) and Vertex AI Pipelines for automated training, evaluation, continuous batch inference, and automated retraining.
  • Optimize High-Scale Data Workflows: Engineer and optimize large-scale BigQuery data extraction, partitioned and clustered dataset transformations, and automated data pipelines handling multi-million row operational datasets.
  • Drive Platform Provisioning & Governance: Review Architectural Requirement Specifications (ARS) and execute infrastructure provisioning across GCP services (Vertex AI, BigQuery, Cloud Run, Cloud Spanner, Cloud Storage, and GKE).
  • Enforce Platform Security & Guardrails: Implement least-privileged Identity & Access Management (IAM), per-pipeline service account bindings, and VPC Service Controls (VPC-SC) perimeters to prevent unauthorized data access and egress leaks.
  • Champion Blast Radius Governance: Conduct comprehensive pre-deployment verification checklists for IAM policies, dependencies, and external partner integrations to guarantee zero service disruption.
  • Standardize CI/CD Automation: Build and maintain reusable GitLab CI/CD runner pipelines for pipeline compilation, automated testing, container image packaging, and progressive environment promotion.
  • Secure AI Tooling & Developer Harnesses: Establish security guardrails and governance policies for internal AI tooling, CLI assistants, and IDE developer harnesses, ensuring secret isolation, token sanitization, and auditability.
  • Support Emerging Agentic AI Integrations: Enable operational runtime configurations and backend service connectivity for Agentic AI frameworks, Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, and conversational agent deployments.
  • Lead Technical Problem Resolution: Troubleshoot complex container dependency builds, private package repository configurations (Google Artifact Registry), and runtime environment discrepancies across Workbench and Cloud Build runners.
  • Foster Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Data Governance, Cloud Operations, Enterprise Security, and external technology partners to ensure platform compliance, high availability, and rapid time-to-market.

 

 

Qualification

Professional Experience & Technical Qualifications

 

  • Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical discipline.
  • Experience: Minimum 5+ years of total experience in software, data, or ML engineering, with at least 3+ years of dedicated hands-on experience in MLOps, DataOps, or DevOps within enterprise production environments.
  • Cloud & Big Data Mastery:
    • Deep operational expertise with Google Cloud Platform, specifically Vertex AI, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, IAM, and VPC Service Controls.
    • Strong experience in BigQuery performance tuning, partitioning, clustering, and stored procedures.
  • ML Pipeline & Orchestration:
    • Proven track record of designing, building, compiling, and monitoring production Kubeflow Pipelines (KFP) or Vertex AI Pipelines.
    • Deep familiarity with model registry workflows, artifact versioning, and lifecycle management.
  • Programming & Automation:
    • Expert-level proficiency in Python, including object-oriented programming, packaging, data structures, and cloud SDK integrations.
    • Strong foundation in Linux environments and shell scripting.
  • DevOps & CI/CD Tooling:
    • Hands-on expertise building enterprise CI/CD workflows using GitLab CI/CD, Docker containerization, Helm, and GitOps methodologies.
    • Experience managing private package repositories using Google Artifact Registry.
  • Security & Governance Acumen:
    • Practical experience securing day-to-day engineering AI harnesses, managing service account tokens, and implementing Data Loss Prevention (DLP) best practices.
  • Certifications:
    • Google Cloud Certified Professional Machine Learning Engineer (Preferred / Nice to have).
    • Google Cloud Certified Professional Data Engineer (Preferred / Nice to have).
    • Google Cloud Certified Professional Cloud Architect (Preferred / Nice to have).
  • Value-Add / Bonus Qualifications:
    • Experience with Agentic AI engineering frameworks (Google ADK, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or MCP servers).
    • Familiarity with RAG evaluation frameworks (such as Ragas or DeepEval) and vector databases.
    • Exposure to Cloud Spanner, Redis/Memorystore, or GraphDB integrations.

 

 

Behavioral Competencies

 

  • Problem-Solving Agility: Exceptional analytical and diagnostic skills with the ability to resolve complex infrastructure, pipeline, and security challenges under fast-paced operational conditions.
  • Proactive Ownership Mindset: High sense of accountability, initiative, and drive to transform operational lessons into scalable, automated standards.
  • Collaborative Communication: Strong communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary squads, data science teams, and vendor partners.
  • Continuous Learning & Adaptability: Eagerness to stay ahead of the curve in emerging MLOps practices, GenAI platform engineering, and modern cloud technologies.

We're looking for a Fullstack Developer with a strong Python foundation. You'll be building backend services and APIs in Python/Django, with the ability to work across the stack when needed. You'll ship real features that directly affect the products our customers rely on.

Nice to Have

raw_description: The work Design, develop, and deploy machine learning models for complex business challenges. Work with stakeholders to understand requirements, define data pipelines, and deliver AI solutions. Implement, optimize, and maintain production ETL workflows for data ingestion, transformation, and management. Write clean, efficient, reusable Python code using NumPy, pandas, scikit-learn, and other relevant data science libraries. Monitor model performance and accuracy, then evaluate and improve deployed systems. Document methodologies, processes, and model decisions to support transparency and reproducibility. What it pays and takes Pay: $50 to $100 per hour. Work type: Remote contractor role with part-time work available. Language: Professional fluency in English. Location: Open to candidates in the United Arab Emirates, Argentina, Austria, Bangladesh, Belgium, Bahrain, Brazil, Canada, Switzerland, Chile, Colombia, Germany, Denmark, Algeria, Egypt, Spain, France, the United Kingdom, Ghana, and Greece. Location: Also open to candidates in Indonesia, India, Italy, Jordan, Japan, Kenya, Kyrgyzstan, Kuwait, Kazakhstan, Lebanon, Sri Lanka, Morocco, Mexico, Malaysia, Nigeria, the Netherlands, Oman, Peru, the Philippines, Pakistan, Palestine, Portugal, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, Thailand, Tunisia, Taiwan, the United States, Uzbekistan, Vietnam, and South Africa. Required skills: Expert-level knowledge of machine learning techniques and algorithms; advanced Python programming; production ETL workflow design and management; data preprocessing; feature engineering; and model evaluation metrics. You must be able to explain complex technical concepts clearly, collaborate with remote distributed teams, and show a track record of delivering robust, scalable machine learning solutions. Helpful background: Experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure; Docker, Kubernetes, or MLflow; and an advanced degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field. How it works You apply here in about two minutes and finish on the hiring platform. The next step is a short AI interview (technical roles include a coding challenge). Passing it is how you qualify for paid tasks, so take it soon after you are invited. The hiring platform's application for this job asks for your resume, your LinkedIn profile, your phone number, your location and answers to 3 screening questions. About AI training work AI training and data labeling is the human work behind modern AI systems. Engineers and other specialists prepare data, build evaluation systems, and improve models, while people with deeper technical experience are paid for applying that expertise to complex AI work. OpenTrain is where people find AI training and data-labeling projects, build a profile, and apply in minutes. Creating an OpenTrain account is free.

raw_description:
< Kembali

Product Data Analyst (Pekanbaru)

Daftar Sekarang

Pekanbaru, Pekanbaru City, Riau, Indonesia

Tipe Pekerjaan

Full-Time (WFO)

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

Analyze user behavior and product performance metrics to provide actionable insights for product decisions and improvements.

Design and implement data tracking systems to measure key metrics across our platform.

Build and maintain clear dashboards to visualize KPIs for stakeholders.

Partner with product managers to identify opportunities and solve problems through data-driven approaches.

Run A/B tests to evaluate feature effectiveness and guide product iterations.

Create analytical models to predict user behavior and uncover growth opportunities within the palm oil supply chain.

Monitor and report on key business metrics focusing on smallholder productivity, supply chain efficiency, and sustainability outcomes.

Analyze agricultural data patterns to optimize product features for farmers and other stakeholders.

Provide business leaders with regular reports and custom analyses to inform strategic decisions.

Maintain clear documentation of data definitions, analysis methods, and insights to strengthen organizational knowledge.

Kualifikasi

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Economics, or related field.

2+ years of experience in product analytics, business intelligence, or similar data-focused roles.

Strong SQL skills for complex data analysis.

Basic Python skills for data analysis and statistics.

Experience with data visualization tools (such as Tableau, PowerBI, or Looker).

Sharp analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities, with skill in turning data into actionable insights.

Understanding of statistical concepts and their practical applications.

Knowledge of product metrics and KPIs in digital platforms or marketplaces.

Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex data insights clearly to non-technical audiences.

Experience in agritech, supply chain, or related industries is a plus.

Knowledge of Indonesian agriculture, especially palm oil, is beneficial but not required.

Willing to be placed in Pekanbaru, Riau.

Tentang Perusahaan

SawitPRO is the best innovator that improves the lives of everyone in the Palm Oil industry. SawitPRO develops an integrated end-to-end agri-platform, creating a win-win-win for people, planet and profit. Our missions are to improve the livelihood of Indonesia’s smallholders, to unlock value for the industry, and to strive in a demanding global market in traceability and sustainability of palm oil products.

We provide platforms that connect the supply chain stakeholders within the palm oil industry (i.e. Palm Oil Mills, Agents, Smallholders, and Agri Input vendors), create a digital ecosystem that removes friction points, and essentially boosts the productivity of the smallholders via access to affordable yet high quality agro-inputs, agronomic services, and high-quality planting materials.

We envision to be the game-changer that improves smallholders’ living standard, and helps our planet to meet the growing global demand for sustainable palm oil.

title: Data Analyst - MODA
raw_description:
1. Mengidentifikasi sumber data yang relevan, mengumpulkan data yang dibutuhkan, serta melengkapi data yang hilang atau tidak lengkap dari sistem internal dan eksternal.
  2. Melakukan pembersihan, validasi, dan persiapan data untuk memastikan akurasi, konsistensi, dan kemudahan penggunaan data.
  3. Mengorganisir dan menyusun data mentah ke dalam format yang siap digunakan untuk analisis dan pelaporan.
  4. Menganalisis dataset untuk menjawab pertanyaan bisnis tertentu dan menghasilkan insight yang dapat ditindaklanjuti.
  5. Mengidentifikasi tren, pola, dan anomali dalam data untuk mendukung pengambilan keputusan berbasis data.
  6. Mengembangkan visualisasi data, dashboard, dan laporan analitis menggunakan tools yang sesuai.
  7. Menyiapkan dan mempresentasikan laporan analisis serta dashboard kepada manajemen eksekutif dan tim proyek.
  8. Melakukan pelatihan dan sesi knowledge sharing, termasuk menyusun materi pelatihan serta mendukung tim lain dalam memahami struktur data dan konsep visualisasi.
raw_requirements:
1. Pendidikan minimal S1 di bidang Sistem Informasi, Ilmu Komputer, Statistik, Matematika, atau bidang terkait.
  2. Memiliki pengalaman kerja minimal 2 tahun sebagai Data Analyst atau posisi lain yang berfokus pada data.
  3. Memiliki kemampuan organisasi, manajemen waktu, penentuan prioritas, dan multitasking yang baik dengan tingkat ketelitian yang tinggi.
  4. Mahir menggunakan Power BI, termasuk data modeling, DAX, pembuatan dashboard, publikasi laporan, dan pengaturan refresh data.
  5. Menguasai Microsoft Excel tingkat lanjut, termasuk Pivot Table, Power Query, formula lanjutan (INDEX-MATCH/XLOOKUP, array formulas), serta Macro.
  6. Memiliki kemampuan SQL yang kuat (GoogleSQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL, atau sejenisnya) untuk query kompleks, ekstraksi, dan transformasi data.
  7. Berpengalaman dalam proses integrasi data; memiliki pemahaman integrasi data SAP melalui SAP GUI menjadi nilai tambah.
  8. Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik serta mampu menjelaskan hasil analisis kepada stakeholder non-teknis.

title: Data Scientist - Credit Risk
raw_description:
Funding Societies | Modalku is the largest SME digital finance platform in Southeast Asia. We are licensed and operating in Singapore, Indonesia, Thailand, Malaysia and Vietnam, and backed by Sequoia India (Peak XV), Softbank Vision Fund, Khazanah and SMBC bank amongst many others. Funding Societies | Modalku provides business financing to small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), which is funded by individual and institutional investors, as well as payments solutions to SMEs and consumers.

Here at Funding Societies | Modalku we live by our core values GETFS:

  • Grow Relentlessly: Strive to become our best, most authentic selves
  • Enable Teamwork, Disable Politics: Only by forging togetherness, we help each other succeed
  • Test Measure Act: Stay curious and reinvent ourselves, through innovation and experimentation
  • Focus on Impact: Create impact through bias for action and tangible results
  • Serve with Obsession: Build win-win relationships for the long-term by having a customer obsession

Key Responsibilities

  • Model Development: Build machine learning models for credit scoring, risk profiling, fraud detection, and customer segmentation. This covers data preparation, feature engineering, and benchmarking against existing scoring logic and business rules
  • Model Validation & Monitoring: Run recurring model performance and stability checks (e.g., AUC, KS, PSI, calibration). Investigate drift or anomalies, and escalate findings with a clear view of what changed and why it matters
  • Analysis & Insights: Perform exploratory and deep-dive analyses on borrower and portfolio data to answer impactful business questions, and present findings in clear, concise summaries
  • Pipelines & Automation: Contribute to model training, scoring, and monitoring pipelines, writing clean, version-controlled, reproducible code

Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in data science or statistics, including hands-on model development. Exposure to financial services or fintech is a plus
  • Degree in statistics, mathematics, computer science, economics, data science, or a related quantitative field
  • Proficiency in Python (pandas, scikit-learn or similar) and SQL
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously
  • Strong attention to detail and clear written communication

Benefits

  • Time off - We would love you to take time off to rest and rejuvenate. We offer flexible paid vacations as well as many other observed holidays by country. We also like to have our people take a day off for special days like birthdays and work anniversaries
  • Flexible working - We believe in giving back the control of work & life to our people. We trust our people and love to provide the space to accommodate each and everyone's working style and personal life
  • Medical benefits - We offer health insurance coverage for our employees and dependents. Our people focus on our mission knowing we have their backs for their loved ones too
  • Mental health and wellness - We understand that our team productivity is directly linked to our mental and physical health. Hence we organize org-wide fitness initiatives and engage partners to provide well-being coaching
  • Tech support - We provide a company laptop for our employees and the best possible support for the right equipment/tools to enable high productivity

Interested to know more about us? Learn about our Stories here.

Review project materials and source materials against project guidelines and apply project rubrics. Review model outputs and write clear feedback that can improve model behavior. What it pays and takes Pay: $86.54 to $120.19 per hour. Time: 20+ hours per week. Work arrangement: Remote, full-time contract work with required travel. The hiring platform's application for this job asks for your resume, your LinkedIn profile, your phone number, your location and answers to 3 screening questions. About AI training work AI training is the human work behind systems that learn from examples, including reviewing model outputs, applying guidelines, and writing clear feedback. People with strong technical or subject knowledge are important because careful human judgment helps make training data and evaluations more useful.

Contract

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

We are looking for a Full Stack Developer who can build scalable web applications while also being able to quickly translate business and product requirements into functional prototypes and technical solutions.

This role is suitable for someone who enjoys working across frontend, backend, APIs, databases, system architecture, and product experimentation. You will not only be responsible for writing production-quality code, but also for validating ideas quickly through prototypes using tools such as Replit, Lovable, and other AI-assisted development tools.

Key Responsibilities:

Develop and maintain end-to-end web applications, covering frontend, backend, API, database, and third-party integrations.

Translate business requirements, product requirements, and user problems into practical technical solutions.

Build rapid functional prototypes and MVPs using tools such as Replit, Lovable, AI coding assistants, and other modern development platforms.

Convert prototypes into production-ready applications when the product has been validated.

Design and implement REST APIs, database structures, authentication, authorization, and system integrations.

Develop responsive and user-friendly interfaces with consideration for mobile-first and low-bandwidth environments.

Evaluate technical trade-offs between speed, scalability, maintainability, cost, and complexity.

Work closely with Product Managers, Designers, Business Teams, and other Engineers to iterate on product solutions.

Build proof-of-concepts and experiments to validate product assumptions before investing in full production development.

Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and determine when a prototype should evolve into a custom-built system.

Ensure applications are reliable, secure, maintainable, and properly documented.

Debug and troubleshoot issues across the frontend, backend, database, API, and deployment environments.

Beyond coding skills, the candidate is expected to demonstrate:

Understand what problem is being solved before deciding what to build.

Break down ambiguous business problems into clear technical and product requirements.

Identify assumptions and determine which assumptions need to be validated first.

Design practical experiments or MVPs to validate ideas quickly.

Understand the difference between a prototype, MVP, and production system.

Make pragmatic decisions about when to use an existing tool versus building a custom solution.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

Strong knowledge of frontend and backend development.

Good understanding of APIs, databases, authentication, Git, testing, and debugging.​ Experience integrating third-party APIs and services.​

title: GoTo Financial - Senior Data Scientist - Lending
raw_description:
About The Role

In this role, you will be an integral player within Data Science team based on Jakarta. You will take the wheel in building, evaluating, and monitoring credit risk models for a variety of consumer and merchant lending products GoPay offers in Indonesia. Your responsibilities will include enhancing our credit risk models by leveraging innovative and cutting-edge algorithms on GoTo data and third-party data vendors. Most importantly, your efforts will work to bring wider financial inclusion to more people in the region and beyond.

What You Will Do

  • Drive End-to-End Impact: Take complete ownership of the machine learning lifecycle. You will conceptualize, build, deploy, and monitor data models that directly influence key business metrics and bottom-line results.
  • Innovate Credit Risk Strategy: Lead the development of advanced consumer credit risk models. Apply rigorous statistical analysis and ML techniques to optimize lending decisions, balance risk, and fuel sustainable business growth.
  • Partner with Product & Business: Act as a strategic bridge between data and business strategy. Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to translate ambiguous business challenges into scalable, production-ready data science solutions.
  • Champion Technical Excellence: Set the standard for robust model evaluation and clear documentation. You will advocate for data science best practices and distill complex technical concepts into actionable insights for non-technical leadership.

What You Will Need

  • Bachelor degree or above in science and engineering related majors such as statistics, mathematics, physics, computer science, etc.
  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience in building, evaluating, and monitoring credit risk models.
  • Excellent understanding of machine learning techniques and algorithms.
  • Comfortable using Python, SQL, and UNIX Shell.
  • Understand business concerns and formulate them as technical problems that can be solved using data and math/stats/ML.
  • Self-driven and entrepreneurial with a strong sense of ownership, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.
  • Good communication skills and ability to present technical concepts to a non-technical audience.
  • Able to write model documentation clearly and concisely and support recommendations with research and data.

About The Team

Our team leverages big data from the GoTo universe, as well as external data, to build various predictive models to support the risk strategy team in real-time credit underwriting and management of the customer lifecycle Cicil (BNPL) and Pinjam (cash loans) products. As our model scores are key inputs to risk decisioning (e.g. approval/rejection of loans, credit limit adjustments), we are also able to see the direct impact of our models on the business and our customers.

We are a growing team and are constantly looking for opportunities to use data science to enhance our credit and fraud risk management capabilities. We are focused on growth and efficiency. We are all about open knowledge sharing and self-improvement. We believe that “Data Science is a team sport.”

About GoTo Group

GoTo is the largest digital ecosystem in Indonesia. GoTo's mission is to 'empower progress' by offering technology infrastructure and solutions that help everyone to access and thrive in the digital economy.

The GoTo ecosystem provides a wide range of services, including mobility, delivery, payments, financial services, and technology solutions for merchants. The ecosystem also provides e-commerce services through Tokopedia and banking services through its partnership with Bank Jago.

About Gojek

Gojek is Southeast Asia’s leading on-demand platform and pioneer of the multi-service ecosystem with over 2.5 million driver partners across the regions offering a wide range of services such as transportation, food delivery, logistics and more. With its mission to create impact at scale, Gojek is committed to resolving consumer problems and raising standards of living by connecting consumers to the best providers of goods and services in the market.

About GoTo Financial

GoTo Financial accelerates financial inclusion through its leading financial services and merchants solutions. Its consumer services include GoPay and GoPayLater and serve businesses of all sizes through Midtrans, Moka, GoBiz Plus, GoBiz, and Selly. With its trusted and inclusive ecosystem of products, GoTo Financial is open to new growth opportunities and aims to empower everyone to Make It Happen, Make It Together, Make It Last.

title: Senior Data Scientist (Remote)
raw_description:
Reimagine access. Reimagine ownership. Build the future with Cinch.

Cinch is Southeast Asia's leading circular tech subscription company, redefining how people and businesses access technology. Instead of adding to the growing e-waste crisis, we enable affordable, sustainable access to devices through subscriptions that maximize reuse and extend their lifecycle.

We operate across B2C, B2B, and B2B2C channels, including major partnerships with global leaders like Samsung. Our model sits at the intersection of powerful mega trends—sustainability, embedded finance, and the shift from ownership to access—creating a massive opportunity to reshape the future of tech consumption.

At Cinch, we are builders with high standards, a bias for action, and a shared mission to create a generational company that outlasts us. Freshly funded by leading institutional investors and growing rapidly, we're creating an environment where ambitious people can do the best work of their careers—and where the work has real, lasting impact.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to build the credit models that decide who Cinch lends to, on what terms, and how we collect. Every subscription at Cinch is a customer relationship and a credit exposure on a physical device, so your models directly shape growth, losses and asset returns.

You will own credit and risk models end to end: from data exploration and feature design through validation, deployment and monitoring. You will work with SQL and Python, partner with Data, Product and Engineering teams, and turn model outputs into decisions the business can act on. You are expected to be AI-literate and comfortable working with Claude. We expect responsible AI use, and the correctness of all work submitted remains the author's own responsibility.

Responsibilities

Risk and credit modelling

  • Build, validate and maintain credit scoring models for new and repeat subscribers - A Score and B Score models.
  • Develop early-warning and delinquency models, and support collections strategy and prioritisation
  • Run experiments and champion/challenger tests to prove a model improves approval rates, losses or recovery before it scales
  • Track model performance over time (stability, drift, bias) and retrain when it degrades

Data and features

  • Collect and blend data from multiple sources (applications, payments, devices, bureau and alternative data) into clean, documented feature sets
  • Work with data analysts and engineers on dimensional models and data pipelines so features stay consistent between training and production
  • Define and track the risk KPIs the business relies on (approval rate, default rate, loss per cohort, recovery rate)

Decisioning and partnership

  • Turn model outputs into clear decision rules and recommendations to guide credit policy at Cinch.
  • Present findings and trade-offs to leadership in plain language, including what the model cannot tell us
  • Partner with Risk & Data leadership on credit policy and regulatory expectations in each market

Standards, AI and mentoring

  • Document models so another data scientist can reproduce and audit them
  • Use AI tools (Claude Desktop, Claude Code) to speed up exploration, coding and documentation, and set the standard for responsible use with sensitive customer data

Qualifications

Must-have

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science or a related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 6-9 years of experience in data science or advanced analytics, including building models that went into production
  • Strong SQL and Python (including familiarity with all the relevant frameworks and packages such as pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost or similar) for data manipulation and modelling
  • Solid grounding in statistics and machine learning for classification and risk: logistic regression, gradient boosting, calibration, cross-validation, and evaluation metrics such as AUC, KS and Gini
  • Experience with model validation, monitoring and documentation, and explaining model results to non-technical stakeholders
  • Working knowledge of dimensional modelling and data pipelines, and the ability to work with analysts and engineers on feature data
  • Working proficiency with AI tools

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience in fintech, lending, consumer credit, e-commerce or subscription businesses
  • Credit scorecard development, collections analytics or fraud detection
  • Experience with cloud data warehouses and modern data stack tools (for example BigQuery, dbt, SQLMesh)
  • Experience with BI tools such as Apache Superset or Looker
  • Experience with workflow automation tools such as n8n, and with deploying models to production
  • Familiarity with regulatory expectations for credit data and model use in Malaysia or other Southeast Asian markets

title: Senior Data Scientist - Credit Risk
raw_description:
Funding Societies | Modalku is the largest SME digital finance platform in Southeast Asia. We are licensed and operating in Singapore, Indonesia, Thailand, Malaysia and Vietnam, and backed by Sequoia India (Peak XV), Softbank Vision Fund, Khazanah and SMBC bank amongst many others. Funding Societies | Modalku provides business financing to small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), which is funded by individual and institutional investors, as well as payments solutions to SMEs and consumers.

Here at Funding Societies | Modalku we live by our core values GETFS:

  • Grow Relentlessly: Strive to become our best, most authentic selves
  • Enable Teamwork, Disable Politics: Only by forging togetherness, we help each other succeed
  • Test Measure Act: Stay curious and reinvent ourselves, through innovation and experimentation
  • Focus on Impact: Create impact through bias for action and tangible results
  • Serve with Obsession: Build win-win relationships for the long-term by having a customer obsession

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly motivated and skilled Senior Data Scientist to join our dynamic team. You will work with a diverse team of experts in a collaborative and innovative environment, analysing complex datasets, developing predictive models, and providing insights that drive business decisions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Model Development & Deployment: Design, build, and productionise machine learning models for credit scoring, risk profiling, fraud detection, and customer segmentation, calibrating existing scoring logic and business rules to improve predictive performance
  • Model Governance & Documentation: Prepare and maintain model documentation (data sources, features, assumptions) and drive models through internal review, credit review, and sign-off ahead of deployment, ensuring models remain interpretable, robust, and aligned with regulatory standards
  • Analytical Insights & Impact: Perform deep-dive analyses to uncover trends and actionable insights that improve model performance and product strategy, translating findings into clear, data-driven narratives and building self-serve tools, dashboards, and model monitoring frameworks for transparency and measurable impact
  • Model Infrastructure & MLOps: Build and maintain scalable model pipelines and infrastructure supporting the end-to-end lifecycle (training, validation, deployment, monitoring), and automate workflows to reduce operational overhead and enhance reproducibility and governance
  • Leadership & Mentorship: Mentor junior data scientists and analysts through structured guidance and technical reviews, and lead high-impact data science initiatives from problem scoping to final delivery

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in data science, preferably within the fintech or financial services industry
  • Proven experience developing and deploying machine learning models in a production environment
  • Strong background in statistical analysis and machine learning
  • Expertise in credit modelling and risk management is an added advantage
  • Experience navigating formal model governance processes (documentation, committee review, sign-off) in a regulated environment
  • Comfort incorporating AI-assisted tools (e.g. code generation, automated documentation) into day-to-day model development

Benefits

  • Time off - We would love you to take time off to rest and rejuvenate. We offer flexible paid vacations as well as many other observed holidays by country. We also like to have our people take a day off for special days like birthdays and work anniversaries
  • Flexible working - We believe in giving back the control of work & life to our people. We trust our people and love to provide the space to accommodate each and everyone's working style and personal life
  • Medical benefits - We offer health insurance coverage for our employees and dependents. Our people focus on our mission knowing we have their backs for their loved ones too
  • Mental health and wellness - We understand that our team productivity is directly linked to our mental and physical health. Hence we organize org-wide fitness initiatives and engage partners to provide well-being coaching
  • Tech support - We provide a company laptop for our employees and the best possible support for the right equipment/tools to enable high productivity

Interested to know more about us? Learn about our Stories here.

title: ESG Data & Reporting Analyst (Project-Based)
raw_description:
ESG Data & Reporting Analyst berperan untuk mendukung pengumpulan, pengolahan, dan validasi data kuantitatif untuk Sustainability Report (SR) dan Annual Report (AR). Tugasnya mencakup pemetaan data sesuai indikator dan standar pelaporan, pemeriksaan konsistensi data, formula, satuan, periode, dan perhitungan year-on-year, serta identifikasi kesenjangan atau inkonsistensi melalui pemeriksaan silang. Peran ini juga mengelola sumber data dan dokumentasi validasinya, serta membantu menyusun lembar kerja pelaporan, dasbor, dan analisis data.

Kandidat dengan kinerja yang baik berpeluang untuk diangkat menjadi karyawan tetap (full-time) di KTM Solutions.

title: Staff-Tech. Planning & Development
raw_description:
Role Purpose

As a Staff-Tech Planning & Development professional within the CX Tech Planning & Project Tracking unit, this role will lead the hands-on development, configuration, and end-to-end delivery of customer experience automation and A.I initiatives. The role combines technical expertise with strong project execution, connecting core platforms such as Siebel CRM, Salesforce Service Cloud, and RPA with customer-facing solutions including A.I Agent Assist, A.I Copilot, Social Media Automation, Voice A.I, Self-Service Portals, Semantic Search, and automated Knowledge Bases.

 

Working closely with IT, Martech, Product, Finance, and Business Process teams, this role will turn customer and business needs into practical, scalable digital solutions. This role will directly improve how frontline agents work and how customers access support by rapidly building, testing, and deploying solutions that increase efficiency, enable self-service, and improve the overall customer experience. 

 

Staff-Tech Planning & Development is responsible to identify, evaluate, and propose new technologies and AI solutions to enhance the customer experience. Conduct research, analyze data, and support the development of innovation proposals, pilots, and Proofs of Concept. Support day-to-day project enablement for technology and digital initiatives, including stakeholder coordination, milestone and dependency tracking, risk and issue escalation, and the transition of validated solutions from POC or pilot into implementation. Work closely with cross-functional teams to gather insights and contribute to digital innovation within the customer experience organization. This role is also responsible to apply responsible-AI and data-protection considerations to technology and AI use cases, in line with UU PDP No. 27/2022 and internal policy.

Minimum Requirements

Education & Background:

  • Bachelor's degree (S1) in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Data/A.I, Business Administration with a technology focus, or a related field
  • Minimum 1-3 years of experience in an analytical role, preferably with exposure to technology research, data analysis, or digital initiative implementation; experience in the telecom industry is a plus. Fresh Graduate with Internship, apprenticeship, or substantial final-project experience in technology or digital initiatives may be counted toward this requirement.
  • Working or internship experience within a digital start-up or fast-paced digital environment is highly preferred

Technical Proficiency

  • Working proficiency in SQL and at least one scripting language (e.g. Python or JavaScript/Node.js), sufficient to query data, automate routine tasks, and prototype simple internal tools with understanding of REST API, JSON, webhooks, system integration, and data flow.
  • Working experience with a cloud CRM platform (e.g. Salesforce.com, Microsoft Dynamics 365, or equivalent), including day-to-day configuration or administration support; a practitioner certification such as Salesforce ADM 201 will be a plus.
  • Basic understanding of software development principles and methodologies, with the ability to develop and deploy simple internal applications or scripts to address specific operational challenges or create workarounds
  • Familiarity with API integration concepts, cloud service models (SaaS / PaaS), common integration patterns, and data flows, sufficient to assess vendor solutions and communicate requirements to technical teams
  • Fundamental understanding of AI/ML concepts, specifically Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Semantic Search, and Conversational Voice/Chatbot frameworks. Including and not limited to generative AI, LLM, AI Agent/Agent Assist, Prompt Engineering, Voice AI, Semantic Search, and AI-powered Knowledge Base.
  • Practical experience using generative AI tools in a work or academic context (e.g. prompt design, summarization, drafting, first-pass analysis), together with a realistic understanding of their limitations
  • Working familiarity with a data visualization or BI tool (e.g. Power BI, Tableau, or Looker Studio), and with spreadsheet-based estimation of benefits, costs, and ROI
  • Exposure to workflow automation or low-code platforms (e.g. Power Automate, n8n, or equivalent) used to digitalize manual processes.

Project Management Proficiency

  • Working proficiency in Bahasa Indonesia and English, sufficient to document requirements and present findings to both business and technical audiences
  • Understanding of Digital Transformation principles and their application within a customer service organization, including how technology can reshape customer interactions and operational processes
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum fundamentals: backlog management, user stories, sprint planning, stand-ups, UAT, retrospectives, and release management.
  • Familiarity with Git/GitHub, Jira, Confluence, Postman, monday.com or equivalent delivery tools.
  • Familiarity with Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems and with digital communication channels relevant to customer service (e.g. mobile apps, messaging platforms, social media)
  • Ability to act as both Project Coordinator and Hands-on Builder, moving from requirement → design → development/configuration → testing → deployment → measurement.
  • Basic understanding of CI/CD and DevOps practices is highly desirable.
  • Ability to translate complex business processes and SOPs into technical user stories while collaborating across IT, Marketing, Product, Finance, and Customer Care operations.
  • Basic understanding of contact center and digital channel technology — IVR, chatbot and voicebot, omnichannel routing, and knowledge management — and of the operational metrics they influence (AHT, FCR, self-service containment, CSAT).
  • Awareness of data privacy and responsible-AI obligations affecting customer data, including UU PDP No. 27/2022, and of why human oversight is required in AI-assisted customer journeys
  • Basic understanding of project management methodologies and principles (e.g. Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid approaches), and familiarity with at least one project or work tracking tool (e.g. Jira, Asana, Trello, or Microsoft Planner)
  • Exposure to workflow automation or low-code platforms (e.g. Power Automate, n8n, or equivalent) used to digitalize manual processes
  • Conversational Voice/Chatbot frameworks. Including and not limited to generative AI, LLM, AI Agent/Agent Assist, Prompt Engineering, Voice AI, Semantic Search, and AI-powered Knowledge Base.

Secondary Competency

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret data and identify trends
  • Excellent research and information-gathering skills

title: Credit Risk Modeling
raw_description:
• Develop, review, and enhance credit risk modeling methodologies, frameworks, policies, and procedures, particularly for corporate and commercial banking segments. 
  • Conduct quantitative analysis, monitoring, evaluation, and forecasting of Expected Credit Loss (ECL/CKPN) to support effective credit risk management. 
  • Develop and maintain credit risk models, including Probability of Default (PD), Loss Given Default (LGD), and Exposure at Default (EAD), incorporating forward-looking methodologies. 
  • Support the implementation, validation, and continuous improvement of credit risk models, including application risk, behavioral risk, and collection risk models. 
  • Perform periodic and event-driven reviews of credit risk models, methodologies, and frameworks to ensure model effectiveness and regulatory compliance. 
  • Analyze the impact of credit risk modeling methodologies on portfolio quality, business performance, and risk exposure. 
  • Conduct model performance monitoring, backtesting, and evaluation to ensure model accuracy and reliability. 
  • Support the development and enhancement of CKPN/ECL management platforms, dashboards, and advanced analytics capabilities. 
  • Prepare risk modeling reports, management overlays, and analytical insights for internal stakeholders, management, and external parties. 
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align credit risk modeling practices with business objectives, financial reporting requirements, and regulatory standards. 
  • Support credit risk governance activities, including coordination with internal and external auditors and continuous improvement of risk management processes.
raw_requirements:
Mandatory Qualifications:
  1. Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Actuarial Science, Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, or other relevant fields. 
  2. 3–6 years of experience in credit risk modeling or quantitative modeling, preferably within the banking or financial services industry. 
  3. Strong analytical and statistical skills, with proficiency in quantitative methodologies for risk model development. 
  4. Proficiency in large-scale data processing, feature engineering, and model development using Python, R, or SQL. 
  5. Solid understanding of model development methodologies, model performance evaluation, and interpretation of modeling results to support business decisions and risk management. 
  6. Good understanding of banking risk management principles, particularly credit risk and quantitative risk measurement.
Preferred Qualifications:
  1. Experience in PD modeling, including forward-looking approaches such as logistic regression, transition matrices, and vintage/survival analysis, as well as LGD and EAD/CCF estimation. 
  2. Experience in developing, implementing, or maintaining statistical and machine learning models. 
  3. Familiarity with model documentation, model governance, validation, backtesting, and model performance monitoring. 
  4. Knowledge of Expected Credit Loss (ECL/CKPN) calculation, management overlays, and financial reporting requirements. 
  5. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel; familiarity with SAS is an advantage.

Grab Internship Program Overview:

The Grab Internship Program offers students and recent graduates the opportunity to work alongside teams driving Southeast Asia's leading everyday superapp. As an intern, you will not just observe—you will actively contribute to real business challenges, partner with cross-functional teams, and gain hands-on experience in how large-scale, tech-enabled operations run. Be a part of an exciting internship from Jan - June 2027. Work placement may vary across Indonesia, ie, Jakarta, Medan, Surabaya, Bali, Semarang, Yogyakarta or where Grab operates.

Get to Know the Role

In this role, you will bridge market reality and data-driven product strategy. You will conduct primary and secondary market research, analyze large-scale datasets, and evaluate program performance across our core verticals (Mobility, Deliveries, and Financial Services). Your insights will directly influence upcoming feature developments, pilot launches, and business operations.

Market & Product Research:

Design and run qualitative and quantitative research studies (surveys, user interviews, competitive benchmarking) to identify user needs and market opportunities.

Data Exploration & Analysis:

Extract, clean, and analyze datasets to monitor key performance metrics, spot operational trends, and diagnose business anomalies.

Actionable Insights & Recommendations:

Translate raw findings into clear, structured reports, decks, and recommendations for product managers and business leads.

Experimentation & Program Support:

Support the pilot rollout of new product features or operational programs by tracking feedback and evaluating post-launch adoption.

Dashboard & Reporting Hygiene:

Assist in maintaining team tracking dashboards and data spreadsheets to keep business metrics transparent and accessible.

title: AIF - AHM - Plant & Facilities Engineering Intern
raw_description:
• Merancang, menganalisis, dan mengevaluasi alur proses manufaktur serta fasilitas pendukung (utilitas dan bangunan) dengan mempertimbangkan kelayakan teknis dan finansial, kepatuhan terhadap standar HSE dan ISO, serta penerapan teknologi ramah lingkungan (green technology).
  • Menerjemahkan desain ke dalam implementasi melalui penyusunan Engineering Specification Request (ESR), instalasi mesin dan peralatan, pelaksanaan komisioning, serta evaluasi kinerja.
  • Menginvestigasi kegagalan proses, mengidentifikasi akar permasalahan (root cause analysis), dan menstandarkan tindakan perbaikan untuk meningkatkan kualitas dan keandalan operasional.
  • Melaksanakan pengujian teknis dan ilmiah, termasuk pengujian geometri dan validasi, untuk mendukung analisis engineering.
  • Mengembangkan standar kerja yang mencakup proses, material, peralatan, dan bahan habis pakai (consumables).
  • Mendukung pengembangan dan penyempurnaan prosedur pemeliharaan mesin, peralatan, utilitas, dan fasilitas bangunan.
  • Membantu pengelolaan suku cadang, bahan habis pakai, serta perencanaan dan pengendalian biaya pemeliharaan.
  • Mendukung kegiatan identifikasi dan analisis kerusakan (troubleshooting) pada mesin dan sistem utilitas, termasuk perencanaan tindakan pemeliharaan preventif dan korektif.
  • Mengidentifikasi dan merekomendasikan perbaikan prosedur pemeliharaan untuk meningkatkan efektivitas operasional, keandalan peralatan, dan efisiensi biaya.
raw_requirements:
• Mahasiswa aktif minimal semester 5 dari jurusan Teknik Mesin, Teknik Elektro (Otomasi atau Mekatronika), Teknik Metalurgi, Teknik Kimia, Teknik Otomotif, atau Teknik Desain Produk.
  • Memiliki IPK minimal 3,00 dari skala 4,00.
  • Mampu membaca gambar teknik, skema mesin, diagram perpipaan (piping diagram), struktur bangunan, serta diagram kelistrikan/ladder diagram.
  • Memiliki pemahaman yang baik mengenai proses manufaktur, permesinan, tata letak pabrik (plant layout), dan sistem penanganan material (material handling).
  • Memahami prinsip K3 (HSE) dan standar ISO di lingkungan manufaktur, serta memiliki wawasan mengenai teknologi ramah lingkungan (green technology) dan standar praktik terbaik global (global benchmarks).
  • Memahami prinsip ergonomi dan studi gerak (motion study).
  • Memahami konsep pemeliharaan preventif dan korektif (preventive and corrective maintenance) serta KPI pemeliharaan, seperti MTTR, MTBF, dan FM.
  • Memiliki kemampuan analisis dan pemecahan masalah yang kuat serta berorientasi pada perbaikan berkelanjutan (continuous improvement).
  • Mampu melakukan identifikasi masalah (troubleshooting) dan analisis pada sistem permesinan maupun utilitas.
  • Mampu menggunakan software engineering seperti AutoCAD, CATIA, atau SolidWorks.
  • Mahir menggunakan Microsoft Office.

raw_description:
Senior Integration Engineer, Orchestration team

Team

Engineering

Location

Jakarta, Indonesia

Job Type

Full-time

The role at a glance

Skills you need

What we offer

Life at Grab

The role at a glance

Get to know the team

The Orchestration team takes care of all automation and integration needs of GTS (Grabber Technology Solutions = Grab's Enterprise IT team) and beyond. Our work directly enhances Grabbers' productivity by delivering process and workflow automation. We are expanding our team and seeking individuals passionate about building and managing complex workflows and automated processes across multiple systems or and business practices.. If this resonates with you, come join us!

Get to Know the Role

You will report to the Lead Integration Engineer, Orchestration team and you will be responsible for development, testing, deployment, production support and maintenance of workflow automation and integration solutions predominantly built on iPaaS. In this role, as a Senior engineer, you will also lead the development of high-quality software solutions.

This role is onsite based in our South Jakarta, Indonesia office.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

You will lead the development of workflow automations and integration solutions using Workato, n8n,UIPath, ensuring adherence to coding standards and best practices.

You will provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers, fostering a culture of learning and collaboration.

You will conduct code reviews for junior engineers to ensure quality, performance, and maintainability, offering constructive feedback.

You will enforce quality assurance processes, executing testing and validation procedures, and implementing CI/CD pipelines for automated testing.

You will maintain up-to-date technical documentation, including system designs and configurations, to facilitate troubleshooting and knowledge sharing.

You will respond to production incidents and service disruptions, conducting root cause analysis and implementing preventive measures, including rotational early morning shifts for critical incidents.

Read more

Skills you need

What Essential Skills You Will Need

At least 5 years of experience in software engineering, DevOps, or infrastructure roles, emphasizing orchestration, automation, and cloud technologies. Hands-on experience in using popular orchestration tools such as n8n, Workato, UIPath etc., would be preferred.

Proficiency in software development practices and tools, including version control systems (e.g., Git), code review processes, agile development methodologies and practices.

Experience working with data query languages (eg., SQL) and robust understanding of data integration and transfer standards.

  2. Menguasai Ketersediaan dan Performa aplikasi dan infrastrukturnya secara menyeluruh
  3. Menyediakan dukungan infrastruktur & aplikasi 24X7 infra & app support
  4. Membuat, mengelola, dan memelihara seluruh infrastruktur menggunakan IaC.
  5. Melakukan onboarding aplikasi baru dengan proses peninjauan kesiapan produksi.
  6. Bekerja sama dengan Tim Developer untuk memiliki pemahaman mendalam tentang arsitektur aplikasi dan hambatannya.
  7. Mengidentifikasi kesenjangan observabilitas dalam aplikasi & infrastruktur dan bekerja sama dengan pemangku kepentingan untuk memperbaikinya dengan memanfaatkan perangkat yang tepat.
  8. Mengelola pemadaman dan melakukan RCA terperinci dengan pengembang serta mengidentifikasi cara untuk menghindari situasi tersebut.
  9. Mengotomatiskan kerja keras dan pekerjaan berulang.

  2. Minimal 6 tahun pengalaman kerja dalam mengelola high traffic site, layanan mikro berskala besar, dan infrastruktur dengan keterampilan pemecahan masalah yang sangat baik.

  11. Pengalaman dalam membangun jalur CI/CD dengan alat seperti Jenkins, GitLab, dll. 
  12. Pengalaman dengan beberapa penyimpanan data merupakan nilai tambah (Kafka/RabbitMQ, Redis, Elasticsearch). 
  13. Wajib menguasai salah satu bahasa skrip DevOps (Bash / Python / Go).

title: Point of Sales Platforms
raw_description:
ROLE PURPOSE

 

 

Lead the development, enhancement, integration, and operational excellence of Point of Sales (POS) applications within the Sales & Distribution ecosystem. Drive technology modernization, process automation, and AI-powered innovation to improve sales productivity, operational efficiency, system reliability, and user experience across all sales channels.

 

Key Responsibilities

 

A. POS Application Leadership & Ownership

  • Own the end-to-end POS application lifecycle, including architecture, development, configuration, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
  • Ensure POS applications support business requirements across sales channels, outlets, dealers, and distribution operations.
  • Drive application simplification, standardization, and modernization to support business transformation and system integration.
  • Define technical roadmaps, development priorities, and delivery plans aligned with Sales & Distribution business objectives.

B. Technical Development & Solution Engineering

  • Lead and actively participate in hands-on development, coding, debugging, configuration, and technical problem-solving.
  • Design scalable, secure, and high-performance application solutions using modern technologies and development practices.
  • Manage API development, middleware integration, database design, and connectivity with core systems and other enterprise applications.
  • Establish coding standards, conduct code reviews, and ensure compliance with IT architecture, security, and quality standards.
  • Troubleshoot complex production issues and drive root cause analysis (RCA) and permanent corrective actions.

C. AI Development & Intelligent Automation

  • Develop and implement AI-powered solutions to improve POS capabilities, sales processes, and operational efficiency.
  • Build AI applications and services using appropriate AI models, APIs, frameworks, and enterprise data.
  • Explore and implement Generative AI and Agentic AI to automate repetitive tasks, accelerate development, and improve operational decision-making.
  • Develop AI-assisted monitoring, anomaly detection, predictive analysis, and intelligent incident management capabilities.
  • Identify opportunities to integrate AI into sales operations, outlet management, transaction monitoring, and user support.
  • Ensure AI solutions meet enterprise security, data privacy, governance, accuracy, and reliability requirements.

D. System Integration & Technology Modernization

  • Ensure seamless integration between POS and other Sales & Distribution systems, including outlet management, dealer management, sales applications, incentive systems, and enterprise platforms.
  • Drive API standardization, reusable services, and system interoperability across business applications.
  • Lead technology upgrades and migration initiatives to improve scalability, maintainability, and integration readiness.
  • Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture, Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, IT Operations, and external technology partners.

E. Service Reliability & Operational Excellence

  • Ensure POS application availability, performance, scalability, and transaction reliability.
  • Monitor application health, identify performance bottlenecks, and implement proactive monitoring and automation.
  • Lead incident resolution, problem management, and service improvement initiatives.
  • Establish service KPIs, technical documentation, disaster recovery readiness, and operational handover standards.

Required Technical Competencies

 

 

  • Strong knowledge of POS applications, sales distribution systems, and enterprise application architecture.
  • Hands-on software development skills in relevant programming languages and frameworks.
  • Experience in REST APIs, microservices, middleware, databases, and enterprise system integration.
  • Practical experience developing and deploying AI solutions, including Generative AI, LLM integration, or Agentic AI.
  • Knowledge of AI frameworks, prompt engineering, RAG, AI agents, and model/API integration.
  • Understanding of CI/CD, DevOps, automated testing, application security, and performance optimization.
  • Experience with cloud platforms, observability tools, and AI-assisted monitoring is an advantage.

Leadership & Business Competencies

  • Strategic thinking and technology roadmap development.
  • Strong people leadership, coaching, and talent development.
  • Agile delivery and project management.
  • Stakeholder communication and vendor management.
  • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making.
  • Ability to translate business challenges into scalable technology and AI solutions.
  • Strong ownership and accountability for delivery and production stability.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • POS application availability and transaction success rate.
  • Application performance and reduction in critical incidents.
  • On-time delivery of development projects and business requirements.
  • Number and business impact of AI solutions successfully implemented.
  • Productivity improvement and operational cost reduction through automation.
  • Reduction in manual processes and mean time to resolve incidents (MTTR).
  • Quality of system integration and successful technology modernization.
  • Team capability development and engineering quality improvement.

Minimum Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • Significant experience in application development, enterprise systems, and IT solution delivery minimal 3 years
  • Proven experience leading technical teams and managing business-critical applications.
  • Demonstrated hands-on capability in software engineering and solution design.
  • Practical experience building or implementing AI-powered applications or automation solutions.
  • Experience managing  partners, budgets, projects, and cross-functional stakeholders.

  2. Melakukan konfigurasi dan implementasi modul Odoo Accounting, termasuk pengaturan Chart of Accounts, jurnal, pajak, vendor bills, customer invoices, pembayaran, dan rekonsiliasi bank.
  3. Mengumpulkan dan mendokumentasikan kebutuhan pengguna melalui proses requirement gathering, penyusunan Business Requirement Document (BRD), serta pemetaan proses bisnis (business process mapping).
  4. Melakukan pengujian sistem (functional testing dan UAT) untuk memastikan konfigurasi Odoo sesuai dengan kebutuhan bisnis.
  5. Memberikan pelatihan dan pendampingan kepada pengguna terkait penggunaan modul Accounting pada Odoo.
  6. Melakukan identifikasi masalah, analisis kendala, serta koordinasi dengan tim teknis untuk penyelesaian permasalahan sistem.
  7. Menyusun dokumentasi konfigurasi, panduan penggunaan, dan laporan implementasi sistem.
  8. Memberikan dukungan pascaimplementasi serta melakukan evaluasi untuk meningkatkan efektivitas proses akuntansi menggunakan Odoo.

title: CUDA Engineering Expert (English)
raw_description: The work Support AI training work centered on high-performance GPU programming. Profile GPU kernels and apply CUDA optimization techniques to improve computational throughput on modern hardware. Identify kernel bottlenecks and recommend targeted optimization strategies using performance metrics. Refactor C++ and CUDA code for maintainability, efficiency, and adaptability across GPU architectures. Implement GLSL and WebGPU shader logic and integrate graphics or compute workflows with existing pipelines. Record optimization steps, findings, and performance improvements in actionable technical reports. Contribute technical perspective to design discussions and evaluations of GPU-based approaches. What it pays and takes Pay is $60 to $120 per hour. Remote, part-time contract work. Open to candidates in the United Arab Emirates, Argentina, Austria, Bangladesh, Belgium, Bahrain, Brazil, Canada, Switzerland, Chile, Colombia, Germany, Denmark, Algeria, Egypt, Spain, France, the United Kingdom, Ghana, Greece, Indonesia, India, Italy, Jordan, Japan, Kenya, Kyrgyzstan, Kuwait, Kazakhstan, Lebanon, Sri Lanka, Morocco, Mexico, and Malaysia. Also open to candidates in Nigeria, the Netherlands, Oman, Peru, the Philippines, Pakistan, the Palestinian Territories, Portugal, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, Thailand, Tunisia, Taiwan, the United States, Uzbekistan, Vietnam, and South Africa. Fluent in English. Advanced C++ development skills in high-performance computing environments. Hands-on GLSL and WebGPU experience for graphics or compute shader development. Proficiency with GPU profiling tools such as Nsight, Visual Profiler, or similar tools. Strong analytical ability to reason about kernel performance across hardware generations. Excellent written and verbal communication for technical documentation and reporting. Experience working remotely with cross-disciplinary teams is helpful. Prior AI experience is not required. How it works You apply here in about two minutes and finish on the hiring platform. The next step is a short AI interview (technical roles include a coding challenge). Passing it is how you qualify for paid tasks, so take it soon after you are invited. The hiring platform's application for this job asks for your resume, your LinkedIn profile, your phone number, your location and answers to 6 screening questions. About AI training work AI training is the human work behind modern AI systems, including reviewing code, evaluating model outputs, and preparing examples. OpenTrain helps people find these projects, build a profile, and grow a career in AI training and data labeling; specialist contributors are valued for their technical expertise.

Medical image annotation adds expert human judgment to images so AI systems can learn from clearly identified regions and accurate medical information.

title: Document Annotation Expert
raw_description: The work Review Korean-language PDF annotations to help ensure text is accurately captured and interpreted for model-training datasets. Review annotated Korean PDF documents in a daily quality assurance queue. Check that document fields have correctly placed bounding boxes. Verify Korean content, reading order, and OCR transcription accuracy. Review and correct character-level OCR errors in Korean text. Validate classifications for tables, charts, text blocks, key-value pairs, headers, footers, and other structured document elements. Review table boundaries, row and column alignment, merged cells, headers, and logical hierarchy. Return issues to annotators with clear, actionable notes when needed. Escalate recurring error patterns and unclear guidelines to project leads. Confirm that reviewed documents meet the required quality standard before submission. What it pays and takes This is a part-time contract role for document annotation quality assurance. Pay: up to $40 per hour. Time: 20+ hours per week. Location: Open to candidates in South Korea. Language: Fluent Korean with strong accuracy in character-level review, spacing, grammar, and usage. Communication: Strong professional English for project communication and written feedback. Experience: Prior experience in quality assurance, data annotation, document review, content review, OCR validation, or a closely related role. Tools and workflows: Hands-on familiarity with OCR systems, document parsing workflows, PDF annotation, or structured document review. Annotation skills: Ability to verify, revise, add, and classify bounding boxes around document elements. Document review: Ability to review dense layouts, table structures, merged cells, headers, footers, and multi-column text. Work quality: Strong attention to detail, consistency, and a disciplined self-review approach. Helpful background: Experience with OCR-processed documents and document understanding workflows, including Korean-language layout, transcription, and annotation issues across large volumes of work. How it works Apply on OpenTrain with your resume, then complete the application on the hiring site. About AI training work AI training is the human work behind systems that learn from examples, including reviewing documents, labeling data, and correcting model outputs. OpenTrain is a free platform where people find AI training projects, build a profile, and apply in minutes.

• Mengembangkan aplikasi Android native yang yang scalable, aman, dan berkinerja tinggi.

  • Menerjemahkan kebutuhan bisnis dan desain UI/UX ke dalam implementasi teknis.

  • Menulis kode yang bersih, terstruktur, dan mudah dipelihara.

  • Melakukan coding, testing, dan debugging aplikasi Android.

  • Mengintegrasikan aplikasi dengan backend melalui RESTful API.

  • Melakukan code review dan memastikan kualitas kode.

  • Mengoptimalkan performa, keamanan, dan stabilitas aplikasi.

  • Menangani bug fixing dan improvement pada aplikasi yang sudah berjalan.

  • Berkolaborasi dengan tim backend, UI/UX, dan product.

  • Mengelola proses build, release, dan maintenance aplikasi di Google Play Store.

  • Mengikuti perkembangan teknologi Android dan menerapkan best practices terbaru
raw_requirements:
• Pendidikan minimal S1 di bidang Teknik Informatika, Sistem Informasi, Ilmu Komputer, atau bidang terkait.

  • Pengalaman pengembangan aplikasi Android minimal 2–3 tahun.

  • Menguasai Kotlin untuk Android (minimal 2 tahun pengalaman).

  • Pernah mengembangkan dan mempublikasikan minimal 2 aplikasi di Google Play Store.

  • Menguasai Android SDK, Android Studio, dan tools pendukung Android development.

  • Memahami Android component (Activity, Fragment, Service, Broadcast Receiver).

  • Memahami arsitektur aplikasi Android (MVVM, MVP, atau Clean Architecture).

  • Familiar dengan RESTful API dan integrasi API seperti Retrofit, OkHttp, atau sejenis.

  • Memahami lifecycle management, state management, dan background processing.

  • Memahami Material Design dan Android UI/UX best practices.

  • Terbiasa menggunakan Git untuk version control.

  • Memahami unit testing dan/atau instrumentation testing (JUnit, Espresso menjadi nilai tambah).

  • Pengalaman menggunakan CI/CD, Docker, atau containerization menjadi nilai tambah.

  • Mampu membaca dan memahami dokumentasi teknis.

  • Memiliki problem-solving skill yang baik, analitis, dan mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim.

  • Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik dan sikap proaktif.

title: IT Development Program (ITDP)
raw_description:
IT Development Program (ITDP) adalah program pengembangan yang dirancang untuk mempersiapkan talenta terbaik menjadi profesional IT yang kompeten dalam mendukung transformasi teknologi dan digital Bank Syariah Indonesia. 

Pada program ini,  Peserta akan mendapatkan pembelajaran terstruktur, pendampingan dari praktisi berpengalaman, serta pengalaman langsung dalam pengembangan teknologi, digitalisasi proses bisnis, dan implementasi solusi inovatif untuk mendukung pertumbuhan Bank. Peserta juga mendapatkan pembelajaran menyeluruh mengenai industri perbankan, strategi bisnis, transformasi organisasi, inovasi produk, pengelolaan risiko, hingga optimalisasi proses bisnis

Join the Transaction Platform team at Grab, where we own the end-to-end transaction lifecycle for our customers. Every Grab order — food, mart, express, ride — flows through the systems this team owns.

Get to Know the Role

You will report to the Senior Engineering Manager, Transaction Platform, and play a key role in shaping the systems that power every Grab order. This is a hands-on engineering position with significant ownership and cross-functional influence. This will be an onsite role based in Jakarta.

Design, build, and operate order services that remain correct, fast, and resilient under peak load, ensuring consistently high performance at scale.

Own reliability end to end — defining SLOs, participating in on-call rotations, managing capacity planning, and leading postmortems to drive continuous improvement.

Design and implement highly reliable, scalable services for Grab's Transaction Platform systems, with a strong focus on availability, fault tolerance, and operational excellence.

Partner closely with product, design, and analytics teams to build the product, ship features, and design experiments that inform data-driven decisions.

Participate in code and design reviews, mentor peers where appropriate, and help the team maintain high development standards and engineering best practices.

You will have 6+ years of software engineering experience in a distributed systems environment, with a track record of designing, developing, and implementing large-scale, highly available online services.

You have experience engaging with AI tools and emerging technologies to enhance productivity, improve workflows, and contribute new ideas.

You will have strong Computer Science fundamentals in algorithms and data structures, with a strong understanding of system performance and scaling.

You will hold a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

title: AVP-Product Sales Specialist - Predictive Model
raw_description:
Role Purpose

The purpose of this role is to manage and optimize the organization's analytics solutions portfolio by driving product strategy, commercialization, performance monitoring, and operational excellence.

 

The role is responsible for identifying market opportunities, translating business problems into analytics-driven solutions, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable products powered by data, AI, predictive modeling, and advanced analytics. It also establishes governance and best practices to ensure consistent product quality, efficient execution, and continuous improvement across the analytics portfolio.

 

Area of Responsibilities

Key Activities

Analytics Solutions Product Management
  • Manage the lifecycle of analytics-based solutions from ideation, enhancement, commercialization, and post-launch optimization.
  • Analyze product, commercial, and customer performance to identify growth opportunities, adoption trends, and improvement initiatives across the analytics solutions portfolio.
  • Collaborate with Data Science, Engineering, Product, Sales, Growth, Marketing, and external partners to translate business challenges into scalable analytics solutions.
  • Support the development and commercialization of AI, predictive modeling, geospatial, customer intelligence, and other data-driven solutions that leverage internal and external datasets.
  • Conduct market research, competitive benchmarking, and customer discovery to identify new business opportunities, use cases, and product enhancements.
  • Define business requirements, product positioning, pricing recommendations, packaging strategies, and go-to-market support for analytics solutions.
  • Develop dashboards, KPIs, and reporting frameworks to monitor product adoption, revenue performance, customer engagement, operational health, and business impact.
  • Evaluate customer feedback, usage patterns, and commercial performance to recommend feature enhancements, model improvements, or service optimization.
  • Work closely with technical teams to prioritize product roadmap initiatives and ensure solutions align with customer needs, data governance standards, and business objectives.
  • Support proof-of-concepts (POCs), pilots, and production deployments by coordinating cross-functional stakeholders throughout implementation and post-launch review.

 

Requirements

  • Minimum S1 degree from a reputable university, majoring in Business Management, Data, or Information Technology.
  • At least 5 years of experience in sales or similar roles, preferably with exposure to government sector projects.
  • Strong knowledge of word processing, spreadsheet, database, and presentation software.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with government stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with telecommunications products and services.
  • Strong projection and forecasting skills to drive business growth.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively with cross-functional teams.

What we offer

Life at Grab

The role at a glance

Get to Know the Team

Business Platform builds products and platforms that help merchants and businesses onboard, operate, grow, and serve consumers at scale across Southeast Asia. Our team develops backend systems that power merchant profile management, seller workflows, business configuration, catalog-related capabilities, and the integrations needed to keep these experiences reliable, secure, and scalable.

You will join a team working on practical e-commerce and merchant-domain problems with clear business growth. The team partners well with product, design, data, and other engineering teams to improve how merchants manage their business on Grab. We value ownership, communication, and engineers who can turn possibilities into reliable software.

Get to Know the Role

You will report to a Senior Software Engineering Manager in the Business Platform tech family and build backend systems that support merchant and e-commerce experiences in Grab ecosystem.

This is a senior engineer role who can own delivery from technical design through rollout and production operations. You will build APIs, services, and workflows that support merchant onboarding, profile management, seller operations, and internal platform integrations. You will also help improve engineering quality through code reviews, operational improvements, and daily technical leadership within the team.

As Grab continues building as an AI-driven organization, you will be expected to use AI tools thoughtfully in engineering work and contribute to product ideas that make merchant and e-commerce experiences more efficient and intelligent. If you enjoy building production-ready systems and taking responsibility for what happens after deploy, we would like to hear from you.

You will be base onsite at our Petaling Jaya, Selangor, Malaysia office.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

You will design, build, and maintain critical backend services, APIs, and asynchronous workflows that power merchant onboarding, seller operations, and e-commerce experiences.

You will independently own delivery from technical design to rollout, including implementation planning, testing strategy, monitoring, and rollback readiness.

You will improve the correctness, reliability, and observability of systems that manage merchant profile data, store configuration, catalog-related workflows, and business rules.

You will investigate production issues, identify root-causes, and implement durable fixes across service boundaries, operational processes, and data flows.

You will partner with product managers, designers, and engineers across teams to translate business requirements into pragmatic technical solutions and measurable outcomes.

You will raise engineering quality through code reviews, design discussions, refactoring, and improvements to testing, monitoring, and team development practices.

You will use AI tools and latest technologies to improve engineering productivity, accelerate analysis, prototype ideas, and contribute better solutions for implementation and operational workflows.
