Senior IT Project Manager

Team

Business Strategy

Location

Jakarta, Indonesia

Job Type

Full-time

The role at a glance

Skills you need

What we offer

Life at Grab

The role at a glance

Get to Know Our Team

The OCO Office's People Program Management Office helps Grab solve complex organisational challenges and turn ideas into practical outcomes.

Our work sits at the intersection of people, technology, and operations. Every programme brings a new problem to solve, a new frontier to explore, or an opportunity to improve how Grab works. We continually challenge our own standards, experiment with better ways of working, and build solutions that make a lasting difference.

If you enjoy creating clarity from complexity, questioning the status quo, and helping teams deliver meaningful change, you will find plenty to keep you busy here.

Get to Know the Role

As a Senior Project Manager, you will lead complex, cross-functional programmes across multiple domains. You will drive business outcomes via the projects you manage, align stakeholders, track risks and dependencies.

You will work closely with People, Technology, Engineering, Product, Operations, and country teams. You will also help strengthen PMO practices, reporting, governance, and delivery standards across the organisation.

At Grab, we're committed to enabling those closest to the problem to solve it using AI, and this extends to how we run our programmes. As a Senior Project Manager, you're expected to actively use AI tools to accelerate planning, reporting, risk analysis, and documentation and to bring an experimental mindset to identifying where AI and automation can remove friction from delivery work, while applying sound judgement on confidentiality and data handling.

This is an onsite role based in Indonesia, reporting to the Manager, Program Management. If you enjoy bringing order to complicated work and making progress visible, we would like to hear from you.

title: AVP-Telco Cyber Security Operation Expert
raw_description:
Role purpose

The primary purpose of the AVP Telco Cyber Security Operation Expert is to lead and oversee the continuous monitoring, detection, and response to cyber threats targeting the organization's Telco infrastructure, applications, and digital assets. This role is responsible for ensuring operational excellence in cyber defense by driving incident response strategy, coordinating cross-functional collaboration, and strengthening threat detection capabilities across multiple technology domains.
The incumbent will lead the entire incident lifecycle — from initial triage, forensic analysis, and containment to post-incident review and improvement. They are also expected to provide expert insights into emerging threat landscapes, develop proactive defense mechanisms, and recommend technology and process enhancements to mitigate cyber risks.
This role aims to ensure the resilience, integrity, and continuity of the Telco ecosystem by minimizing business disruptions, preventing data compromise, and aligning security operations with corporate and regulatory standards.

 

Scope of Work

Area of Responsibilities

Key Activities

Continuous security monitoring and management

Ensure the continuous monitoring and proactive management of security risks within the organization's Telco environments, applications, and Telco infrastructure to promptly identify and mitigate any malicious activities.

Lead the optimization of detection capabilities, SIEM rules, and alert correlation for improved incident visibility

Incident Detection and response Operation

Take charge of the entire process of containing, eliminating, and recovering from Telco security incidents by following well-established guidelines.

Forensic Analysis

Perform forensic data collection and analyze threats to ascertain the extent and root cause of incidents, enabling effective recovery and preventing future occurrences.

Threat Intelligence Analysis:

Stay informed about the latest cyber threats through threat intelligence sources. Use threat intelligence to enhance proactive detection capability for any anomaly for any potential security incidents

SLA monitoring

Implement security operational metrics to assess the effectiveness of incident response and track the progress in restoring the integrity of infrastructure and business services following security events.

 

Requirements

Qualification:

  • Minimum bachelor’s degree in relevant field (Information Technology / Electrical Engineering /Telecommunication Engineering, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Communications, Information Security or a related field).
  • Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience in Cyber Security Operations, specifically within the telecommunications industry.
  • Proficiency in using forensic tools and analysist techniques
  • Strong knowledge in Application Security. Have in-depth understanding related with application security concepts, principles, and best practices.
  • Proficiency in security protocols, cryptography, authentication, authorization, security vulnerabilities, and remediation techniques. Familiarity with programming languages and frameworks is a plus.
  • Proficient in: LINUX, Windows Servers, Unix.
  • Ability to analyze and identify actions to be taken.
  • Excellent time management skills and ability to multi-task and priorities work
  • Working well under pressure
  • Good communication and influence skill
  • Strong understanding of all Information Security Domains
  • Sound understanding of businesses supported and security principles and policies
  • Knowledge of network, system, and application monitoring technologies

 

Related Experience:

  • Demonstrated experience in information security and proficiency in configuring and managing security technologies such as firewalls, IDS/IPS, proxy, email-GW, AV for Servers, APT
  • Experience in Cyber Security Operations, specifically within the telecommunications industry.
  • Proven track record of successfully managing and mitigating security threats in a Telco environment.
  • Proficient in using and configuring Telco-specific security tools and platforms.
  • Strong knowledge of network security protocols and technologies relevant to telecommunications systems.
  • In-depth understanding of telecommunications infrastructure, protocols, and technologies.
  • Familiarity with the unique security challenges and threats faced by Telco operators.
  • Incident Response Experience. Practical experience in developing and executing incident response plans, including system/devices forensics and post-incident reporting.
  • Familiarity with integrating threat intelligence feeds into security solutions for proactive threat detection
  • Have strong communication skills, one can effectively convey complex security concepts to both non-technical individuals and leaders.

 

 

Skills:

  • Information System Management
  • Operational Management
  • Enterprise Risk Management
  • Software Engineering
  • ICT Security Management
  • Telco Knowledge
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills (fluency in English is required)
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills with a proven ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams, including IT, Security, Compliance, and Legal.
  • Strong analytical skills to identify security risks, assess their potential impact, and devise effective solutions.
  • Good communication skill both writing and verbally to be able to work together with all employees in the company.
  • Ability to convey message in clear, concise and simple way to various employees in the company.
  • Ability to deliver and develop presentation in front of different audience and answering their questions.
  • Have integrity, confidentiality, and independence.
  • Collaboration and Teamwork: Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams, especially with development and Telco teams, to integrate security into the software development life cycle.
  • Project Management: Project management skills to plan, execute, and monitor security initiatives effectively.

Life at Grab

The role at a glance

Get to know the Team

The Business Platform team at Grab focuses on empowering a diverse range of Southeast Asian merchants—from local street stalls to international franchises—by providing them with professional tools via the GrabMerchant Super App and Portal. By leveraging data from billions of monthly transactions, the team delivers insights and innovative features that enhance efficiency and customer engagement, effectively leveling the playing field for smaller businesses. Operating as a distributed team across Indonesia and Singapore, they prioritize stability and quality to directly impact merchant profitability and ensure that business owners can focus on their core operations.

Get to know the role

We are seeking talented & passionate Engineers to join our team, you will have opportunities to work on multiple backend services as well as participating in merchant immersions, talking directly to the end-users, identifying their challenges and how we can help them in their work life. raw_description:

Head of Product (Jakarta)

Daftar Sekarang

Jakarta, Indonesia

Tipe Pekerjaan

Full-Time (WFO)

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

Own and drive product strategy from

zero-to-one

, ensuring alignment with long-term product vision and company strategy, and communicate it clearly to stakeholders and users.

Lead

experimentation-driven product development

, including rapid prototyping, MVP launches, A/B testing, and iterative validation.

Define, maintain, and execute product roadmaps, ensuring milestones are delivered on time with measurable impact.

Discover user pain points through qualitative research and deep data analysis; collaborate closely with analytics teams to translate insights into actionable product decisions.

Prototype product functionality and collaborate with design/UX teams to deliver best-in-class user experiences.

Develop go-to-market strategies and partner with growth teams to drive adoption, engagement, and retention.

Apply

growth-hacking principles

to product development, focusing on scalable acquisition, activation, and monetization levers.

Be highly analytical and data-driven; define success metrics and continuously measure product performance.

Lead, coach, and develop product managers, designers, and analysts, fostering a culture of experimentation, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Proven experience working in agile development environments.

Strong communication skills in English, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders.

Exceptional problem-solving skills with structured and strategic thinking.

Strong collaboration and teamwork capabilities across cross-functional teams.

Ability to work independently in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

Kualifikasi

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Mathematics, Business, or other related fields.

8+ years of experience in Product Management, with demonstrated ownership of products from zero-to-one and scaling stages.

Strong track record in experimentation, growth initiatives, and data-led decision making.

Experience using Product Management tools (e.g. Trello, GitHub Issues, Google Drive).

Experience using Prototyping tools (e.g. Figma).

Familiarity with Data Analytics tools (e.g. Metabase, Google Analytics).

Experience in palm oil or agribusiness-related companies is preferred.

Nice to have: Background in top-tier management consulting and/or investment banking, with exposure to strategy, growth, due diligence, or complex business problem-solving.

Willing to undergo a 2-month probation period in Pekanbaru, Riau.

Tentang Perusahaan

SawitPRO is a cutting-edge green digital agritech startup located in the heart of Jakarta. Our mission is to be the best innovator that improves the lives of everyone in the palm oil industry. Through our integrated end-to-end agri-platform, we create a win-win-win scenario for people, planet, and prosperity.

We provide integrated apps that connect the supply chain stakeholders in the palm oil industry (Mills, DO Agents, Smallholders, Harvesters, Drivers, etc.). Creating a digital ecosystem that essentially boosts their productivity with effortless work documentation, affordable yet original agri-inputs, and agronomist services.

Our commitment extends beyond providing innovative solutions; we aim to nurture every aspect of Indonesia's palm oil industry. By fostering growth and sustainability, we strive to bring positive change to the lives of individuals in the palm oil sector, one at a time.

Sales Fertilizer, Seedling, and Palm Oil Plantation (Pekanbaru)

Daftar Sekarang

Pekanbaru, Pekanbaru City, Riau, Indonesia

Tipe Pekerjaan

Contract

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

Tanggung Jawab Utama

Mengidentifikasi dan mendapatkan prospek (lead) baru serta membangun basis pelanggan yang berkelanjutan.

Mengembangkan dan mengelola pipeline prospek untuk secara konsisten mencapai target bulanan.

Secara proaktif mencari prospek baru melalui berbagai strategi pendekatan langsung.

Mengelola seluruh proses penjualan, mulai dari kontak awal dengan prospek hingga proses penutupan penjualan.

Membangun dan menjaga hubungan yang baik dengan prospek, serta memastikan keterlibatan mereka selama seluruh siklus penjualan.

Mendukung aktivitas yang berorientasi pada pencapaian pendapatan sesuai dengan Business Plan perusahaan.

Bekerja sama dengan tim internal untuk memastikan implementasi strategi berjalan dengan lancar dan efektif.

Peran Sales Executive

Customer Service - Berfokus pada akuisisi dan retensi pelanggan melalui pendekatan layanan pelanggan yang berkualitas.

Mengoptimalkan dan memaksimalkan peluang pendapatan dari basis pelanggan yang ada.

Memberikan pengalaman pelanggan yang berkualitas melalui kombinasi produk, layanan, dan pengelolaan hubungan dengan pelanggan.

Kualifikasi

Gelar Sarjana (S1) dari semua jurusan.

Memiliki pengalaman minimal 2 tahun di bidang penjualan (Sales) atau Business Development. Kandidat yang memiliki pengalaman di industri agribisnis akan menjadi nilai tambah.

Memiliki rekam jejak yang terbukti dalam menghasilkan peluang bisnis dengan hasil yang nyata.

Memiliki jaringan yang luas di industri kelapa sawit.

Memiliki pemahaman yang mendalam mengenai industri kelapa sawit.

Mampu melakukan kegiatan canvassing dan wajib memiliki kendaraan pribadi.

Mampu berkomunikasi dengan baik dalam Bahasa Indonesia dan Bahasa Inggris.

Bersedia ditempatkan di Pekanbaru

Tentang Perusahaan

SawitPRO adalah startup agritech digital hijau yang inovatif dengan kantor pusat di Jakarta. Misi kami adalah menjadi inovator terbaik yang mampu meningkatkan kualitas hidup seluruh pelaku di industri kelapa sawit. Melalui platform agrikultur terintegrasi dari hulu hingga hilir (end-to-end), kami menciptakan manfaat bagi manusia, lingkungan, dan keberlanjutan bisnis.

Kami menyediakan aplikasi terintegrasi yang menghubungkan seluruh pemangku kepentingan dalam rantai pasok industri kelapa sawit, seperti Pabrik Kelapa Sawit (PKS), Agen DO, Pekebun Swadaya, Pemanen, Pengemudi, dan pihak terkait lainnya. Kami membangun ekosistem digital yang mampu meningkatkan produktivitas melalui dokumentasi pekerjaan yang lebih mudah, akses terhadap sarana produksi pertanian yang terjangkau dan terjamin keasliannya, serta layanan agronomis profesional.

Komitmen kami tidak hanya menghadirkan solusi yang inovatif, tetapi juga mendukung pertumbuhan dan keberlanjutan industri kelapa sawit Indonesia. Kami percaya bahwa melalui inovasi dan kolaborasi, kami dapat memberikan dampak positif bagi kehidupan setiap pelaku di industri kelapa sawit.

Assistant Manager, CRM

Team

Marketing, Communications & Public Policy

Location

Jakarta, Indonesia

Job Type

The role at a glance

Skills you need

What we offer

Life at Grab

The role at a glance

Get to Know the Team

The CRM team owns the data-driven customer experience for Grab consumers, delivery partners, and merchants across South East Asia. The team develops the personalization strategy across email, SMS, push notifications, in-app messaging, and other marketing channels, whilst being a crucial part of the team that extends that personalization strategy into our product and service channels.

Get to Know the Role

In this role, you will develop, implement, and manage online marketing strategies with regard to lifecycle campaigns that help to bring growth and retention for Grab across different verticals or services. Using owned, paid channels like SMS and Whatsapp and tools to reach and engage with our App users and Partners. You will report to the CRM Manager and work onsite in our Jakarta office.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

You will take end-to-end ownership of CRM lifecycle campaigns, including defining target audiences, content strategy, and user journeys, which includes testing and executing campaign launches across multiple channels like email, SMS, Push, and In-App communications.

You will champion a personalized and one-to-one communication approach, always keeping the customer-centric mindset in focus by understanding user segmentation/behaviour and identify user insights to be used in lifecycle communication strategies.

You will collaborate with the Data Science team to ensure the successful launch and maintenance of live campaigns and conduct in-depth analysis of campaign results.

You will adopt a data-driven approach to identify growth opportunities, working with Regional and Local Marketing teams to align on comprehensive marketing and CRM strategies and support new product launches.

You will be a Subject Matter Expert for the CRM team, engaging with key stakeholders to recommend best practices, experiment, scale up campaigns, and provide updates on CRM capabilities and priorities.

You will work with Creative and Product teams to ensure communications are on-brand and impactful by briefing communications for campaigns.

Read more

5+ years of experience in Marketing or Business Strategy for B2C customer lifecycle and needs.

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Marketing, or Digital Media.

Experience designing, developing, testing, and launching complex CRM or marketing lifecycle campaigns.

Strong project management and stakeholder engagement skills to manage programs while setting the business direction and managing daily deliverables.

raw_description:
< Kembali

Lead of FFB & B2B Commercial (Pekanbaru)

Daftar Sekarang

Pekanbaru, Pekanbaru City, Riau, Indonesia

Tipe Pekerjaan

Full-Time (WFO)

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

Lead and drive SawitPRO's FFB (Fresh Fruit Bunch) crop commercial strategy, focusing on growth, market expansion, and strategic partnerships to support the acquisitions of FFB sources and funnel these sources into our partner mills.

Develop and execute a comprehensive commercial strategy that aligns SawitPRO's mission to enhance palm oil farming and business practices through increase in FFB growth in all stakeholders

Collaborate with product development and marketing teams to ensure product offerings meet market demands and customer needs.

Identify and pursue new business opportunities, markets, and partnerships to expand SawitPRO's footprint.

Own and develop the customer relationship for 3 distinct types of B2B customers of SawitPRO - Crude Palm Oil mills (CPO Mills), DO Agents/suppliers of CPO mills (suppliers), FFB Ramps and any other actors in the supply chain to help speed up acquisition and activation of the FFB sources.

Optimize and maximise revenue opportunities from the user base

Provide high quality customer experience through a combination of product, service and relationship management

Learn the motivation levels of each different types of customers, their pain points, business opportunities and growth prospects

Cross team collaboration across product, sales, operations, marketing and technology to promote good understanding of the customer

Be an ecosystem builder

Role of the Head, B2B Commercial

Strategy & ideation – The person responsible has to develop the overall strategy and ideas behind the company's FFB crop acquisition, conversion and customer management strategy

Team management – Lead a team of collaborators and contributors for delivering on all aspects of the business development and customer management

Leadership – demonstrate leadership by coming up with innovative ideas  as well as by building and managing a high performance team

Customer Management – Manage 3 distinct types of customers - Palm Oil mills, palm oil mill suppliers / agents, FFB Ramps and any other actors relevant to the FFB Crop Business

Customer Service - Focus on both customer acquisition and retention through a sound customer service approach

Execution KPIs – clearly define execution goals and KPIs to deliver on the experience portfolio of the organization

Senior Management collaboration – work closely with senior management including the CEO, head of product, head of engineering, etc. to deliver on the strategic business outcomes including owning financial KPIs and human KPIs

DDD – Lead the Data Driven Decision (DDD) making across the entire organization. Utilize business intelligence and performance metrics to inform decision-making and strategy adjustments.

P & L - Manage revenue and costs generated from the customer base

CRM - Recommend, implement and own the Customer Relationship Management System for SawitPRO

Kualifikasi

Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Business or Marketing discipline is required.

Min.  10 years’ experience working in Sales, Commercial  business management, growth,, etc. in driving digital adoption among customers with independent P&L responsibilities

Five or more years of progressive leadership experience in leading cross-functional teams and enterprise wide programs, operating and influencing effectively across the organization and within complex contexts

Experience in innovating business models and developing new channels, business models or business transformation

Experience in Sales of consumer industries like fast moving consumer goods (FMCG), consumer banking, digital insurance, FinTech, sharing economy, etc. is preferred

Palm oil industry knowledge would be helpful (optional)

Deep understanding of people and their motivations and behaviours

Relationship building and management of different types of B2B customers

Strong business acumen, including domain-specific knowledge of the manufacturing and resources companies and their business units

Excellent analytical, strategic conceptual thinking and consulting skills.

Strong influence and negotiation skills

Ability to effectively drive people, process and technology change in a dynamic and complex operating environment

Excellent oral and written communication skills, including the ability to explain digital concepts and technologies to business leaders, as well as business concepts to technologists

Must be a passionate human being with strong idealism and vision for a brighter future of Indonesia

Tentang Perusahaan

SawitPRO is the best innovator that improves the lives of everyone in the Palm Oil industry. SawitPRO develops an integrated end-to-end agri-platform, creating a win-win-win for people, planet and profit. Our missions are to improve the livelihood of Indonesia’s smallholders, to unlock value for the industry, and to strive in a demanding global market in traceability and sustainability of palm oil products.

We provide platforms that connect the supply chain stakeholders within the palm oil industry (i.e. Palm Oil Mills, Agents, Smallholders, and Agri Input vendors), create a digital ecosystem that removes friction points, and essentially boosts the productivity of the smallholders via access to affordable yet high quality agro-inputs, agronomic services, and high-quality planting materials.

We envision to be the game-changer that improves smallholders’ living standard, and helps our planet to meet the growing global demand for sustainable palm oil.

raw_description:
Job Summary

The AVP-Fixed Voice Product Management is responsible for driving the strategy, development, lifecycle management, and commercialization of fixed voice services (e.g., SIP Trunking, Hosted PBX, PSTN replacement solutions) for enterprise and SME segments. This role ensures the product portfolio is competitive, scalable, and aligned with market demand, revenue targets, and operational efficiency goals.

Job Details

1.Product Lifecycle Management

  • Own the end-to-end lifecycle of fixed voice products, from launch to retirement.
  • Ensure product relevance through continuous market and customer feedback.
  • Maintain product documentation, feature catalogs, and change logs.

 

2.Operational Excellence

  • Oversee provisioning, activation, and service assurance processes.
  • Monitor SLA compliance and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Collaborate with network and infrastructure teams to ensure deployment readiness.

 

3.Performance & Quality Monitoring

  • Track product performance metrics (revenue achievement, product P&L, etc.)
  • Lead root cause analysis and resolution of recurring service issues.
  • Implement operational dashboards and reporting tools.

 

4.Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Work closely with sales, network, IT, and customer service teams.
  • Ensure alignment between product capabilities and delivery processes.
  • Support pre-sales and post-sales teams with product knowledge and operational insights.

 

5.Commercial Support

  • Provide input to pricing and bundling strategies based on operational feasibility.
  • Support GTM execution with operational readiness and service design.
  • Monitor product profitability and cost-to-serve metrics.

 

6.Team Leadership

  • Lead a lean team of product operations specialists and analysts.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, agility, and customer-centricity.
  • Develop team capabilities in lifecycle and operational management.

 

Minimum Requirements:

 

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree from a well-known university in Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related STEM field.
  • Master’s degree (MBA or Technology Management) is preferred.
  • Professional certification in voice networking, marketing, or related field is a plus.
  • Recent formal and informal education in Artificial Intelligence and its applications is a plus.

 

Professional Experience:

  • 10-15 years of experience in product management, preferably in fixed voice, connectivity, or telecom solutions (e.g., SIP Trunk, Cloud PBX, LAN, WAN, etc.).
  • Experience in the telecom or ICT industry with exposure to enterprise/B2B markets.
  • Strong background in cross-functional collaboration (technology, sales, delivery, operations).
  • Proven experience leading product lifecycle (development, launch, enhancement, support).
  • Hands-on involvement in product PoC, technical support, and pre-sales activities.

 

Expected Skills

  • Technical & Commercial Understanding with solid grasp of voice network technologies (OSI Layer, fiber optic, SBC, Voice Firewall etc.) and enterprise connectivity solutions.
  • Product Management with ability to define roadmap, manage lifecycle, support sales, and ensure delivery excellence.
  • Analytical Thinking and Reporting with ability to monitor performance, revenue, project pipeline, and churn metrics effectively.

title: Sr Officer-ERP System Support
raw_description:
Role Purpose

To act as the primary Person In Charge (PIC) for the ERP platform on the IOH side, serving as the key functional and technical point of contact between business users, IT, and the Managed Services Partner (vendor/mitra). This role is responsible for day-to-day platform ownership — including business requirement coordination, master data and configuration integrity, and cross-module functional oversight — as well as governing the partner's delivery of L1, L2, and L3 Application Managed Services (AMS) across the ERP ecosystem, System Integration, on prem/cloud infrastructure related, middleware, ensuring operational stability, SLA compliance, effective Change Request (T&M) delivery, and adherence to IOH governance, reporting, security, and service acceptance (BAST) standards.

Responsibilities

  • Act as the single Point of Contact (PIC) for ERP system matters on the IOH side; gather and consolidate business requirements from process owners; prioritize and validate enhancement/CR proposals prior to partner execution; safeguard master data, Chart of Accounts, and configuration integrity across modules; provide functional guidance to business users on system usage and process alignment, system integration, and infrastructure utilization awareness.
  • Act as the primary IOH counterpart for the ERP Ecosystem Managed Services Partner; monitor day-to-day delivery of L1/L2/L3 support across ERP ecosystem, Surrounding system, system integration, infra utilization, license monitoring; ensure the partner operates within the agreed operating model, service window, and escalation matrix.
  • Monitor and validate the partner's compliance to SLA targets (response/resolution time per P1-P4, System and integration uptime, First Time Fix Rate); review incident trend and aging-ticket reports; drive corrective action for SLA breaches.
  • Oversee incident and problem management performance across L1/L2/L3 tiers; validate Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and CAPA for P1/P2 incidents; review and endorse Change Request documentation (FDS/TDS), T&M consumption, and enhancement delivery against approved scope.
  • Coordinate impact assessment, regression testing, and stabilization activities for ERP system mandatory quarterly cloud updates; ensure partner readiness and risk mitigation prior to patch deployment.
  • Lead and/or participate in daily operational standups, weekly service reviews, the monthly Executive Steering Committee, and the quarterly Patch & Strategy Alignment forum with the partner; consolidate reporting for management visibility.
  • Ensure the partner adheres to IOH IAM/MFA access standards, data confidentiality requirements, and change governance (no production change without an approved CR and roll-back plan); maintain audit evidence of access and change activities.
  • Validate monthly service evidence (SLA summary, RCA/CAPA, ticket tracker, UAT sign-offs) submitted by the partner and process monthly BAST acceptance in line with IOH governance standards.

Qualification

  • Bachelor's Degree (S1) in Information Systems, Information Technology, Computer Science, Accounting, or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in ERP/IT operations, including at least 2 years in ERP system (Oracle Fusion ERP & EPM) implementation, support, or vendor/managed services governance within a large enterprise environment. Experience overseeing L1/L2/L3 Application Managed Services and SLA-based vendor management is preferred.
  • Working knowledge of Oracle Fusion ERP/EPM modules (GL, AP, AR, FA, PPM, Procurement, Tax, FCCS/TRCS/EDMCS), OCI infrastructure, and OIC integration concepts; understanding of ITSM/ITIL incident, problem, and change management processes; SLA and vendor performance management; strong analytical, reporting, and stakeholder communication skills; proficient in MS Office and reporting tools; good command of English (written and verbal).

• ﻿Melakukan proses pengelolaan dan pengiriman dokumen (contoh: BPKB, polis, fidusia dan lainnya) dari cabang-cabang yang berada di bawah supervisinya sesuai dengan prosedur dan ketentuan yang berlaku, guna mendukung kelancaran proses pembiayaan di cabang.
  • Melakukan proses pengurusan pendaftaran dan atau perpanjangan dokumen kepada pihak ketiga sesuai dengan ketentuan yang berlaku, guna memastikan seluruh dokumen yang dibutuhkan memenuhi ketentuan dan syarat pembiayaan yang telah ditetapkan.

raw_description:
Indonesia sebagai negara dengan penduduk muslim terbesar di dunia, memiliki potensi untuk menjadi yang terdepan dalam industri keuangan Syariah. Meningkatnya kesadaran masyarakat terhadap halal matter serta dukungan stakeholder yang kuat, merupakan faktor penting dalam pengembangan ekosistem industri halal di Indonesia. Bank Syariah memainkan peranan penting sebagai fasilitator pada seluruh aktivitas ekonomi dalam ekosistem industri halal.

Keberadaan industri perbankan Syariah di Indonesia telah mengalami peningkatan dan pengembangan yang signiﬁkan dalam kurun tiga decade terakhir ini. Inovasi produk, peningkatan layanan, serta pengembangan yang menunjukkan trend yang positif dari tahun ke tahun. Bahkan, semangat untuk melakukan percepatan juga tercermin dari Bank Syariah Indonesia yang dimiliki Bank BUMN, yaitu Bank Syariah Mandiri, BNI Syariah, dan BRI Syariah.

Bank Syariah Indonesia menyuguhkan berbagai peluang karir yang akan membantu Anda untuk mengeksplorasi.

Awali perjalanan karir di dunia perbankan, Belajar, bertumbuh dan berkontribusi untuk negeri bersama Bank Syariah Indonesia melalui program BiBiT BSI

Tentang Perusahaan

SawitPRO is the best innovator that improves the lives of everyone in the Palm Oil Industry.

Our mission is to develop an integrated end-to-end agri-platform, creating a win-win-win for People, Planet and Prosperity. Our Vision is to help palm oil smallholders become more PROficient in farming practices, so that they can produce more FFB crop, resulting in greater PROsperity for indigenous communities, also creating PROfitability for our business, PROtection of the natural environment and PROgress of Indonesia

7. Memantau dan mengevaluasi proyek pelanggan yang sedang berjalan guna meningkatkan performa layanan, efisiensi operasional, dan profitabilitas.

10. Berkolaborasi erat dengan tim Operations, Business Development, dan Product untuk memastikan kesesuaian antara demand pelanggan dan kapasitas supply serta kelancaran eksekusi proyek.

11. Menyusun dan menyampaikan laporan kinerja secara berkala (mingguan dan bulanan) terkait penjualan, pipeline pelanggan, dan status AR kepada manajemen.

title: Senior Technical Documentation Parts Annotation Specialist
raw_description: The work Apply specialized professional judgment to AI training materials and turn complex source materials into accurate, structured outputs. Convert engineering drawings and bills of materials into assembly procedures with the correct order of dependencies for technical manuals. Identify and verify industrial replacement parts using photographs, nameplates, manufacturer catalogs, and distributor catalogs. Interpret production patterns, markers, and cutting-room plans for apparel or industrial fabrication. Review annotated image batches, decide whether labels are accurate, and apply project ontologies and annotation guidelines. Write clear reasons for recommendations and quality decisions to support AI model training. Refine documents, photographs, patterns, and annotation data to senior-practitioner standards, then submit accurate deliverables through digital collaboration platforms within agreed timelines. What it pays and takes The work is remote and can be done independently. Pay: $20 to $60 per hour. Time: Less than 20 hours per week. Location: Open to candidates in the countries specified for this role; it is not a worldwide listing. Language: Fluent English. Experience: At least 5 years in mechanical technical writing, industrial parts or application analysis, production pattern planning, or computer vision annotation quality assurance. Knowledge: Strong ability to interpret engineering drawings, bills of materials, technical manuals, parts catalogs, or production layouts. Skills: Experience producing structured, accurate records, reports, manuals, or quality decisions, plus analytical, visual, and spatial reasoning and clear written communication. Additional requirements: Familiarity with complex ontologies, annotation guidelines, or quality-control review environments, and the ability to work independently in a remote setting. Relevant background includes authoring assembly manuals from released drawing packages, matching worn parts to catalog records and supersessions, checking production marker details, or independently reviewing annotation batches. How it works You apply here in about two minutes and finish on the hiring platform. The next step is a short AI interview (technical roles include a coding challenge). Passing it is how you qualify for paid tasks, so take it soon after you are invited. The hiring platform's application for this job asks for your resume, your LinkedIn profile, your phone number, your location and answers to 13 screening questions. About AI training work AI training is the human work behind systems that learn from documents, images, language, and other examples. People with specialized experience are paid to review source material, make careful judgments, and help create accurate training data. OpenTrain helps people find AI training and data-labeling projects, build a profile, and apply in minutes.

title: VP-Head of Financial Non Bank
raw_description:
Role Purpose

VP-Head of Sales is responsible for leading multiple sales teams through Sales Managers to drive segment-level revenue growth, strategic account expansion, and long-term customer value.
This role focuses on defining and executing sales strategies across a portfolio of accounts, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and market opportunities. VP-Head of Sales provides direction and oversight to AVP-Head of Sales or any Account Directors, ensuring consistent execution of account plans, pipeline development, and performance management across teams.
In addition, the role requires strong engagement with senior customer stakeholders, guidance on complex sales opportunities, and oversight of forecasting and business performance. VP-Head of Sales acts as a key link between senior leadership and the sales organization, ensuring strategies are effectively translated into execution and delivering sustainable business growth.

Job Details

Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop end-to-end IT solutions for B2B Financial Non Bank clients.
  • Translate business needs into functional and technical specifications.
  • Identify technological enhancements to drive operational efficiency and customer value.
  • Collaborate with the sales team to understand client needs and strategic direction.
  • Conduct client meetings to gather requirements and present solution options.
  • Provide technical support in client presentations and negotiations.
  • Define project scope, objectives, technical requirements, timelines, and budgets.
  • Align internal teams and resources based on project milestones.
  • Monitor and report project progress against targets.
  • Stay current with trends and emerging technologies in supply chain, energy, and digital transformation.
  • Proactively recommend innovations and technology applications.
  • Drive digital enablement across B2B client solutions.
  • Coordinate across IT, product, and operations teams to ensure solution delivery.
  • Lead multidisciplinary teams during solution development and implementation.
  • Provide coaching and mentoring to solution architects and analysts.

 

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Master’s Degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, or relevant field is preferred.
  • Minimum 12–15 years of professional experience in IT solution development, enterprise systems, digital infrastructure, ICT, cloud computing, ERP
  • At least 5-7 years in a leadership role managing large-scale, cross-functional projects
  • Proven experience in designing and implementing technology-driven solutions for B2B clients in the Financial Non Bank sector
  • Strong background in working directly with enterprise clients and senior stakeholders
  • Strategic thinking and commercial acumen in B2B technology environments.
  • Strong project management and budgeting skills.
  • Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable, cost-effective technical solutions.
  • Leadership, mentoring, and cross-functional team collaboration abilities.
  • Adaptability in fast-paced, client-driven environments.
  • Proven track record in driving segment/portfolio-level revenue growth
  • Strong experience in strategic account management and large-scale deals
  • Experience leading large sales organizations or multi-region coverage

title: Prime Natuna EP - Sr. Structural Engineer
organization_name: Rekrutmen Hulu Migas SKK Migas & KKKS
raw_description:
Responsible for designing structural system for Facility Engineering, Modification & Integrity department and ensure its safe and reliable operation.


Areas of Accountability, Responsibility and Competence:

·     Provide structural design and technical support to the construction team.

·     Assess the design foundation to be able to dynamically adapt to some changes in geological conditions.

·     Defining and recommending design methods, specifications and performance of functional requirements.

·     Review project documents prior to issue for scope and presentation, including checking for technical accuracy.

·     Develop the Structural Integrity Management Plan and databases.

·     Develop, maintain and improve the Subsea and Topsides Inspection Strategies.

·     Ensure Topsides and Subsea Inspection Plans are regularly reviewed and updated in line with the Strategies.

·     Ensure inspection and maintenance activities are performed in line with the Plan.

·     Review and approve topsides and subsea annual inspection scopes.

·     Review and assess critical anomalies identified from inspections and ensure an appropriate risk rating is applied.

·     Agree mitigation measures and remedial actions for critical anomalies and ensure any remedial/repair work is appropriately prioritized.

·     Manage the weight control process and ensure databases are regularly maintained.

·     Provide assurance for DCAF discipline critical deliverables for modifications and projects associated with the Assets.

·     Ensure compliance with Company/Industry Discipline Standards and Performance Standards.

·     Support Independent Competent Person in performing verification activities.

·     Oversee the selection and design of appropriate structural modifications and repairs.

·     Review and agree all major structural discipline related engineering scopes Design & Operating Integrity.

·     Ensure appropriate set of standards, procedures and guidance documents are in place and are being applied to manage structural integrity.

·     Conduct/lead Incident Investigations and provide solutions.

·     Support Asset Hardware Barrier Assessments as required.

·     Monitor costs against agreed budget and review/approve invoices.

·     Develop structural engineering report for FEMI management in a timely manner.

·     Ensure construction, pre-commissioning, and start-up activities for structural systems are delivered safely as per company requirement.·     Performs non-routine tasks and attends such meetings as directed from time to time by FEMI Sr. Manager as opportunity presents in order to meet Company objectives.  Ensures that all relevant managers and subordinates are kept informed of all major opportunities, developments, problems or potential problems, which will impact upon the Business.

·     If necessary to update Structure Integrity Management Scheme (SIMS) and Performance standard

·     Conduct Requalification analysis for platform nearing the end of their design life to extend the service Life. Analysis required are In-place, Fatigue and Push over analysis.

·     Prepare under water inspection Scope of Work, review the report and summarize all finding and provide mitigation.

·     Performs action in Synergy action Production System

·     Performs Change required Task (CR) and Technical Query task (TQ) in Electronic Management of Change (EMOC)

·     Provide advise to other discipline or department regarding structural matter if required.
raw_requirements:
·     Bachelor’s degree in Civil/Structural Engineering.

·     Min. 15 years working experience in structural engineering role for offshore infrastructure within oil and gas industry.

·     In-depth knowledge of detailed engineering and design of structural system for oil and gas offshore infrastructure.

·     In-depth knowledge of offshore infrastructure building and construction.

·     In-depth knowledge of installation analysis, detailed designs, and steel structures.

·     Knowledgeable of relevant structural design codes.

·     Proficient in Ms. Office and other structural engineering tools/software (e.g. STAAD Pro structural analysis and Prostructure 3D modeling software, MicroStation V8 and Autocad).

·     Fluent in English (written and spoken).
